# Daily checks

1. Check 1: Brake pads wear faster in wet weather and on long descents.
2. Check 2: The reading room opens at nine and closes at six on weekdays.
3. Check 3: Maps larger than the tables are kept flat in the plan chest.
4. Check 4: The north bed holds the early beans and two rows of lettuce.
5. Check 5: Water reaches each plot through a drip line laid under the mulch.
6. Check 6: Volunteers record rainfall every morning before the gate opens.
7. Check 7: The tool shed keeps spades, forks and a wheelbarrow with a spare tyre.
8. Check 8: Compost is turned once a week and covered when frost is forecast.
9. Check 9: A rain barrel at each corner collects water from the shelter roof.
10. Check 10: Seedlings start in the cold frame and move out after the last frost.
11. Check 11: Paths between the beds are wide enough for a wheelbarrow to pass.
12. Check 12: The bench by the pond is a good place to sort seed packets.
13. Check 13: Each season ends with a shared meal and a swap of saved seeds.
14. Check 14: The lighthouse lamp turns once every twelve seconds.
15. Check 15: Keepers logged the wind direction at the top of every hour.
16. Check 16: A brass barometer hangs beside the stairs to the lantern room.
17. Check 17: Fog signals sounded in groups of two when visibility dropped.
18. Check 18: The station records temperature, pressure and humidity each minute.
19. Check 19: Readings older than a year move to the archive drive.
20. Check 20: A bicycle chain needs a drop of oil on every link, then a wipe.
